emerging_technology: Tool-using AI agents with constrained software actions
intended_application: Draft and reconcile supplier-invoice exceptions in a sandbox; a human approves every payment and supplier change.
business_need: Shorten exception queues without increasing payment errors.
users_stakeholders: Accounts-payable staff, suppliers, security, finance controller
capabilities_constraints: Assume a test ERP and anonymized historical invoices; no agent integration or safety evaluation exists.
risk_consequence_context: A fabricated invoice or prompt injection could lead to a wrong payment or exposure of supplier data.
management_question: Should management authorize a sandbox evaluation against rules-based exception routing during 2027?
time_horizon: 2027 budget decision; three-month sandbox if authorized
additional_context: Hypothetical teaching case created 2026-11-16 for a prospective 2027 decision; organizational details and the proposed monitoring trigger are assumptions, not observations or forecasts. Conventional baseline: Existing rules and human invoice review. Complement or dependency: Identity-bound tools and audit logging. Proposed monitoring trigger and owner: Controller reviews monthly; revisit if the agent makes any unauthorized write in testing or fails pre-agreed accuracy and labor thresholds. Hype-sensitive assertion to test, not a fact: An agent can independently handle all invoice exceptions reliably.
